issues.display_title: Issue #171: Views Report Comment & Views Report Post
issues.main_description_html:
Create Views Report Comment :

CREATE
OR REPLACE VIEW "public"."views_report_comments" AS
SELECT
ric.id,
ric.category,
ric.reason,
ric.created_at AS report_date,
c.id AS comment_id,
c.parent_id,
c.comment_value,
c.created_at AS comment_created,
u.username AS reported_by
FROM
(
(
report_issue_comment ric
JOIN comment c ON ((ric.comment_id = c.id))
)
JOIN users u ON ((ric.user_id = u.id))
);

Create Views Report Post :

CREATE
OR REPLACE VIEW "public"."views_report_posts" AS
SELECT
rip.id,
rip.category,
rip.reason,
rip.created_at AS report_date,
p.id AS post_id,
p.description,
p.created_at AS post_created,
u.username AS reported_by
FROM
(
(
report_issue_post rip
JOIN posts p ON ((rip.post_id = p.id))
)
JOIN users u ON ((rip.user_id = u.id))
);
